newsitem.title: USA: USDA looks at hog operations with 5,000 plus head.
newsitem.headline: USDA looks at hog operations with 5,000 plus head.

text.p: There were 1,400 U.S. hog operations with over 5,000 head in 1996, accounting for 33 percent of the total inventory, the U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday in its first look at operations of that size.
In the December Hogs and Pigs report, USDA also said places with 2,000 or more hogs on hand accounted for 51 percent of the inventory, topping the 50 percent marker for the first time.
The number of U.S. hog operations totalled 157,450 during 1996, down 13 percent from 1995 and off 24 percent from 1994.
The number of hogs under contract owned by 5,000 plus operations, but raised by contractees, accounted for 21 percent of the total U.S. hog inventory, the department said.
